messages.author: d96caadedd206bba
messages.subject: Shiny Workflow
parts:
I've been doing a lot of development in Shiny lately, but the process is tedious compared to the typical "auto-reload" development setup.

For example, the process of 
  1. coding
  2. running the App (with RStudio's CMD + Shift + Enter launch hotkey)
  3. reviewing changes
  4. repeat ad nauseum
Does anyone have suggested setups for making the Shiny development process smoother?

messages.author: f66be21d595ccb8b
messages.subject: Shiny Workflow
parts: Have you tried using R Shiny Server? You can set up a sever on the cloud running Ubuntu quickly and cheaply these days.

messages.author: d96caadedd206bba
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Workflow
parts:
Yep, I actually work both on Shiny server on Ubuntu and locally.

What I'm looking to do is development automation to speed things up. My main goal is to having my Shiny app auto-reloading on one screen (of a dual-screen setup) while I develop on the other.  I've seen other web developers use tools like Grunt to do this, I might give it a shot.

Best,
Chris
